text: A previously unknown group calling itself the Islamic State Hacking Division posted names, photos and addresses of about 100 U.S. troops online, urging lone-wolf attacks. U.S. officials could not verify the leak, saying the file appeared to contain public information, but the FBI, Pentagon and military branches are investigating and contacting service members. The Army and Navy advised limiting personal information online.
